name: Foundation Knowledge
measures: Concept recall and foundational domain knowledge
scoring: Item-bank player with server-authoritative timer and weighted item response

name: Applied Execution
measures: Hands-on application in realistic scenarios (code / SQL execution)
scoring: Docker-sandboxed execution runner via BullMQ queues
unlocks_when: L1 passed at Bronze tier or above

name: Communication & Domain Judgment
measures: Spoken articulation, trade-offs and domain reasoning
scoring: MediaRecorder audio player -> presigned storage upload -> Claude BARS grading
unlocks_when: L2 passed at Bronze tier or above

name: Verification Defense
measures: Interactive defense of submitted work under follow-up questioning
scoring: Multi-turn defense interview conducted by Vivi (the platform AI copilot)
unlocks_when: L3 passed at Bronze tier or above

name: Capstone Project
measures: End-to-end multi-domain deliverable over a 5-7 day window
scoring: Deliverable split scoring: checklist, rubric and presentation (see split below)
unlocks_when: L4 passed at Bronze tier or above

name: Sequential. L1 is unlocked by default.
L1-L5 define cognitive depth and assessment format for specialization-track certifications. They are not SFIA responsibility levels and are not a proficiency scale per skill.
